18 Copenhagen hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. One snapshot on September 29, 2026 for Nov 3 to Nov 5, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Copenhagen hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 16 of the 18 Copenhagen hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 10, the hotel's own site at 4, Clicktrip.com at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Copenhagen rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 16 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 9, the hotel's own site at 5, Trip.com at 2, Bluepillow.com at 1, Clicktrip.com at 1, dealbase.com at 1, Etrip.net at 1, goseek.com at 1 and 1 other site at 1 between them (a tie counts for each site). Taxes and fees at Copenhagen hotels

At the 13 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 25% ($36 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 24% at Absalon Hotel to 25% at Copenhagen Marriott Hotel. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
